core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace house, Sheerness
core.listing:
A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness offered with no onward chain. For sale by Modern Method of Auction with a 56-day reservation period. The property requires modernisation throughout and benefits from gas central heating and a rear yard.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hall, a reception room and a kitchen on the ground floor. On the first floor there are two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside, there is a rear yard. On-street parking is available and no permit is required.

Station Terrace is located in Sheerness.

For sale by Modern Method of Auction at a guide price of £150,000. A non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT is payable by the buyer in addition to the purchase price. The 56-day reservation period applies. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. Standard construction. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. FTTC broadband available. Good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks. On-street parking, no permit required. No onward chain. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. Mid-terrace house requiring modernisation, offered with no onward chain. Gas central heating and a rear yard. Guide Price £150,000 – reservation fee applies.
keyFeatures: For sale by Modern Method of Auction with a 56-day reservation period
